testcase.name: Step 1 | Register a new user account
Step 2 | Login with the registered user
Step 3 | Browse the product catalog and pick a product
Step 4 | Fetch product details for the chosen product
Step 5 | Add chosen product to the cart
Step 6 | Verify cart contains the added product
Step 7 | Place an order from the cart
Step 8 | Retrieve and verify order details
Step 9 | Process payment for the order via credit_card
Step 10 | Verify payment details are persisted correctly
Step 11 | Duplicate payment on the same order should return 409
Step 12 | Cancel a freshly placed order
